claim_status: Canonical ledger for current headline values and their receipt bindings. Public surfaces are checked against this file and the underlying receipts. Updated: 2026-09-06.

f32_raw.description: Eight independent contexts of 800 shared + 28 unique tokens, with 4-byte f32 K/V elements. Current N=8 size denominator: 2,604,662,784 bytes.

fp16_equivalent.description: The same independent-context geometry with 2-byte fp16 K/V elements. Ratios are exactly half the f32-raw ratios.

bf16_equivalent.description: The same independent-context geometry with 2-byte bf16 K/V elements. Same as fp16-equivalent for ratio purposes.

claim_classes.PPL_validated: Deprecated status label retained for schema compatibility. No current claim may use it until a cache-aligned held-out-continuation benchmark passes.
claim_classes.size_validated_shared_prefix_ppl_degrade: The size denominator and compressed byte totals are receipt-validated. A separate cache-aligned shared-prefix continuation check produced materially worse PPL than the oracle and did not consume shell K/V; no PPL-neutrality or shell-quality claim is admitted.
claim_classes.historical_unadmitted: Historical receipt retained without publication admission because its PPL method predated the cache-aligned held-out-continuation contract.
claim_classes.size_only: Measured byte count for the named config. No PPL bench attached. These numbers are useful for N-scaling trends but are not load-bearing claims.
claim_classes.wire_lossless: The codec's wire format (FB2 / TQB1) is bit-exact: serializing a quantized code and deserializing produces an identical code. This is a per-codec property, not a per-config one.
claim_classes.ppl_neutral: Deprecated alias retained for schema compatibility; no current claim uses this status.

smollm2_wikitext2_n8_lossless_default.config: SmolLM2-1.7B + WikiText-2 aggregate 1024-token fixture (800 shared + 28*8 contiguous unique slices), with an N=8 independent-agent size denominator of 8*(800+28) tokens; default two-tier policy (fib k4_n32 cold + turbo b=4 lossless hot).
smollm2_wikitext2_n8_lossless_default.ppl_window_note: Cache-aligned shared-prefix continuation evaluation over exact target-token interval [800, 1024), 224 targets, on one aggregate fixture produced roundtrip PPL 24.234375 versus oracle 7.203125 (+236.44%). Only reconstructed shared-prefix positions [0, 799) are loaded; shell K/V is not used by this score. No PPL-neutrality or independent-prompt per-agent quality claim is admitted.

smollm2_wikitext2_n8_lossy_default.ppl_window_note: Cache-aligned shared-prefix continuation evaluation over exact target-token interval [800, 1024), 224 targets, on one aggregate fixture produced roundtrip PPL 24.234375 versus oracle 7.203125 (+236.44%). pool_only_smollm2.config: SmolLM2-1.7B + WikiText-2, fib k4_n32 cold pool only, no shell tier.
pool_only_smollm2.admission_note: Historical full-cache/full-input PPL receipt; not admitted under the corrected cache-aligned held-out-continuation method. Any retained size fields are observational only.
pool_only_smollm2.note: The fib codec is a codebook-based vector quantizer, NOT bit-exact lossless. The 21.33x ratio is the codebook size (32 codewords, 2 bits per dim) over the original vector size, less wire overhead.

qwen0_5b_synthetic_n8.config: Qwen2.5-0.5B + synthetic corpus, N=8 agents, multi_agent_compact_lossless_lossy bench.
qwen0_5b_synthetic_n8.warning: Qwen0.5B size-only sweep. The naive_total_bytes denominator is a synthetic-size model (n_agents+1 * n_shared_tokens * num_layers * num_kv_heads * head_dim * 2 * 4), not a captured framework cache. Useful for N-scaling trends; not PPL-validated at N=8.

non_claims.exact_kv_reconstruction: We do NOT claim bit-exact reconstruction of the original K/V tensors. The fib cold tier is a codebook quantizer; the turbo hot tier is a polar/radii quantizer. For the current N=8 two-tier defaults, only the receipt-backed size ratios are publication-eligible; the cache-aligned aggregate fixture degraded from PPL 7.203125 to 24.234375.
non_claims.out_of_distribution_ppl: We do NOT claim PPL-neutrality for the current N=8 two-tier defaults, including on WikiText-2. We also make no quality claim on out-of-distribution corpora, 4K/8K context, or models larger than SmolLM2-1.7B.
non_claims.vs_fp16_framework_cache: We do NOT claim to reduce framework cache bytes directly. proveKV decompresses back to f32 and patches the cache; the framework cache is unchanged in size. The current size claim compares compressed bytes with an explicit denominator of eight independent 828-token f32 K/V contexts; fp16/bf16 figures are paper-derived equivalents.
non_claims.decode_wallclock_speedup_from_batch_path: Wall-clock bench (results/bench/decode_wallclock/, fedora-43, release build, 5 reps) shows the batch decode path (TurboQuantizer::decode_approximate_batch) is 1.54x SLOWER than the per-vec path (TurboQuantizer::decode_approximate) on the msi PPL bench shape. The batch path's docstring claims it amortizes per-call overhead, but the actual cost is dominated by per-vec trig and per-vec allocation that the batch path does not actually batch. Do NOT quote a 'batch decode speedup' number without re-measuring.
non_claims.aggregate_fixture_is_not_independent_age: The PPL receipt scores one aggregate 1024-token fixture over exact target indices [800, 1024). The 40.50x / 76.54x size ratios use a separate explicit denominator: 8 independent contexts of 800 shared + 28 unique tokens. Do not describe the PPL result as eight independent-prompt PPL measurements.
non_claims.shell_quality_not_measured_by_current_n8: The current N=8 PPL window starts at the shared/unique boundary. The cache-aligned forward loads reconstructed positions [0, 799) and recomputes token 799 onward, so the score exercises shared-prefix reconstruction but does not consume the reconstructed per-agent shell K/V. Shell receipts support the size result only; a held-out continuation after each reconstructed shared+unique context is required for shell-quality evidence.

naive_computation.summary: The current size estimand is 8 independent f32 contexts, each with 800 shared + 28 unique tokens: 2,604,662,784 raw bytes. Against 64,306,320 / 34,028,688 compressed bytes, that gives 40.50x lossless / 76.54x lossy. PPL is separately measured on one aggregate 1024-token fixture over target indices [800, 1024).

p0b_rust_gate.claim: P0-B Rust gate: all 99 provekv tests pass with zero failures. Hybrid manifest identity, binary page persistence with BLAKE3 digests, atomic fsync/rename/dir-fsync writes, O(1)-metadata forks, mark-and-sweep GC, and per-component codec policy.

p0c_capture_replay_gate.claim: P0-C capture/replay gate: Qwen2.5-0.5B, 3/3 baselines agree, 48 KV pages, BLAKE3 roundtrip verified, DynamicCache reconstruction, suffix replay produces valid token. Qwen3.5-2B blocked pending transformers architecture support.
p0c_capture_replay_gate.blocker_qwen35: qwen3_5 architecture not in any transformers release

p0c_msi_gate.claim: P0-C MSI gate: Qwen2.5-0.5B on MSI (8-core, 31GB RAM, CPU-only). 5/5 baselines agree (token 34208), 48 KV pages from 24 layers, BLAKE3 roundtrip verified, DynamicCache reconstruction, suffix decode produces valid token.

p0c_gpu_gate.claim: P0-C GPU gate: Qwen2.5-0.5B on MSI GTX 1070 (CUDA 11.8, float16). 5/5 baselines agree (token 34208), 48 KV pages from 24 layers, BLAKE3 roundtrip verified, DynamicCache reconstruction, suffix decode produces valid token.
